name: ROS-GS
aliases: Relightable Outdoor Scenes With Gaussian Splatting
definition: A two-stage pipeline for efficiently reconstructing relightable outdoor scenes using Gaussian Splatting, decomposing geometry, texture, and lighting from multi-view images with unconstrained lighting.
summary: ROS-GS is a two-stage Gaussian Splatting pipeline for relightable outdoor scenes that separates directional sunlight from ambient light and uses deferred shading to fix normal variance artifacts.
